_comment: Steam achievements, as shown on the in-game achievement list and the unlock banner. Each has a name, a _DESC (past tense, what you did) and a _DESC_LOCKED (imperative, what to do), and the Arabic keeps that same tense split. Appliance and mode names are copied from lang/appliances.json and lang/ui.json so an achievement names things the way the rest of the game does. Also here: the two language-menu labels that are not endonyms. SETTINGS_LOCALE_ENGLISH is the slot this mod carries Arabic in, so it is labelled العربية - picking it is what turns the game Arabic. The other SETTINGS_LOCALE_* entries are each language's own name for itself and are deliberately left untranslated.
